user.title: Connect to RTL-SDR Bridge
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the local RTL-SDR bridge service.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the machine running the RTL-SDR bridge.
data_description.port: TCP port used by the bridge. The default is 8099.
data_description.token: Bearer token configured as SDR_BRIDGE_TOKEN on the bridge.
data_description.use_ssl: Enable when the bridge is behind a TLS reverse proxy.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the RTL-SDR bridge.
error.invalid_auth: The RTL-SDR bridge rejected the API token.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while connecting to the RTL-SDR bridge.

abort.already_configured: This RTL-SDR bridge is already configured.
